title: Hongqi HS5 Cluster Dashboard Prototype

versions.prompt: Create one restrained native-looking independent Hongqi HS5 CarPlay cluster dashboard following the brief. Header 80 units; left map rectangle x32 y120 w1216 h456 with abstract map content; trip summaries below at y596; right navigation card x1280 y120 w608 h272 and music card x1280 y416 w608 h272. Emphasize large road guidance and real metadata, polished readable typography, subtle blue panels, no neon or oversized brand marks. Fit everything inside 1920 by 720. Use ONLY the fonts, colors, spacing, and component styles defined in the design system. Do not introduce any fonts, colors, or visual styles not in the design system.
